featured_reviews.name: Srikanth Gade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jitesh comes up as an approachable and proactive tutor but towards the end there is a commercial mindset which destroys the momentum for kids.

We had a comprehensive discussion before the boards and asked him to come up with exam simulations, tricks to reduce mistakes and increase marks, presence of mind techniques etc.

However the response is mediocre and only adds to the frustration of the parents. Tick in a box activity of giving exam papers and untimely follow ups.

Revision only to complete the  course timelines and not make the kids understand where they need to improve.

Exam simulation mechanism was asked explicitly but no efforts were taken in this accord.

Results are not just the testimony of tutors. There is a lot of hardwork and mental agony which the kids and parents go through. Tutors taking credit for results which they don't deserve has become a trend and gravity tutorials is no exception

Disappointed.
